name: investor-tear-sheet
title: Investor tear sheet
for_each: select id,code from institutions where status='active' and kind not in ('broker','index fund') order by code

sections.title: Investor
sections.sql: select name,kind,style,city,country,aum_m as aum_millions,tier,owner,rank,shares,round(pct_bps/100.0,2) as pct,change as change_since_last_register,last_met,meetings_12m,next_meeting from v_holders where institution_id=$1

sections.title: People
sections.sql: select name,role,email,phone from contacts where institution_id=$1 and active order by name

sections.title: Holding over time
sections.sql: select as_at,shares from holdings where institution_id=$1 order by as_at

sections.title: Meetings
sections.sql: select held_on,kind,status,team,sentiment,themes,notes from v_meetings where institution_id=$1 order by held_on desc limit 8

sections.title: Still owed
sections.sql: select f.due_on,t.code as owner,f.action from follow_ups f left join team t on t.id=f.owner_id where f.institution_id=$1 and f.done_on is null order by f.due_on

name: roadshow-itinerary
title: Roadshow itinerary
for_each: select id,code from roadshows order by starts_on desc

sections.title: Meetings
sections.sql: select held_on as day,starts,institution_name as investor,kind,contacts as attending,team as ours,material,status from v_meetings where meeting_id in (select id from meetings where roadshow_id=$1) order by held_on,starts

name: board-ir-report
title: Investor relations report for the board
for_each: select latest::text as id,'board' as name from v_register_dates where latest is not null

sections.title: Top holders
sections.sql: select rank,name,shares,round(pct_bps/100.0,2) as pct,change from v_holders where shares>0 and rank<=20 and $1::text is not null order by rank

sections.title: Who moved
sections.sql: select name,move,prev_shares as before,shares as now,met_in_90d_before as meetings_in_90_days_before from v_movers where $1::text is not null order by change

sections.title: What investors said after each result
sections.sql: select title,meetings,positive,neutral,negative,themes from v_feedback where $1::text is not null

sections.title: Where management time went, last 180 days
sections.sql: select name,meetings,five_pct_plus,one_to_five_pct,under_one_pct,not_holding from v_exec_time where $1::text is not null

sections.title: Broker coverage
sections.sql: select broker,rating,target_cents,updated_on from v_coverage where $1::text is not null order by updated_on desc

sections.title: Disclosure and calendar findings
sections.sql: select rule,issue from v_compliance where $1::text is not null order by rule
